verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a CLI (npx skills) that covers add/search/list/update/remove, but skills.sh itself is a website/leaderboard, and there is no evidence of a documented public API; a community member explicitly requests 'Please make a REST API!' directed at skills.sh, indicating one does not exist, and another comment notes basic package-management operations (updates, version-pinning, uninstalls) aren't even documented.
